key_highlights: ASX ended a volatile week higher but faces headwinds from Wall Street inflation fears and Middle East oil tensions
Iron ore prices under pressure ('roaches seeth'), weighing on BHP, RIO, FMG
Australian home values declined sharply in August; auction sentiment deteriorating — housing crash signals emerging
Aussie interest rate expectations rocket, suggesting market pricing in RBA cut amid sticky housing inflation
Grocery prices remain elevated domestically while global peers see declines, pressuring consumer staples
Political risk elevated: Labor by-election collapse and Joyce signalling shifted dynamics post-WA win
Oil price spike on Hormuz/Middle East tensions; Virgin (QAN.AX) shielded by fuel hedging
Gateway Resources (GAT.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA; X2M, Metal Hawk, Bapcor lead ASX runners
Oil giant retreats on clean energy, exposing limits of ESG investor pressure
Major fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers; Qantas redundancies highlight labour market fragility

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness ('roaches seeth') and Pilbara supply boom pressuring prices; gold exploration positive with Gateway's WA discovery
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term earnings pressure; GAT.AX and gold names (NVS.AX, SGH.AX) offer relative strength

sectors.trend: Rising rate-cut expectations support bank valuations but housing deterioration threatens NPLs; insurance sector under regulatory scrutiny (ASIC cash-settlement concerns)
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rate-cut pricing but face credit-risk overhang; insurance names (WBC.AX, CGF.AX) face ASIC pressure

sectors.trend: Oil spike on Hormuz/Middle East tensions; oil giant retreats on clean energy; Victoria offshore wind auction imminent; data-centre fossil-fuel 'high bar' policy
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil strength; renewable names (LJG.AX, IGN.AX) gain from policy support; QAN.AX insulated by hedging

sectors.trend: Grocery prices stubbornly high domestically; weight-loss drug demand surging; 'dupe' brand trend; major fruit grower cuts 1,000 jobs
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from input costs; CSL.AX benefits from pharma/weight-loss drug demand; FMG.AX (fruit) under pressure

sectors.trend: Home values declining sharply; auction sentiment deteriorating; housing inflation persistent; childcare sector in crisis with closures
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk; construction names (WBC.AX) see reduced pipeline

sectors.trend: SpaceX AI data-centre disruption potential; Australia's 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres; EV uptake accelerating
sectors.implications: Local tech/infra names (WES.AX, SGP.AX) benefit from data-centre build; EV supply chain (SGM.AX) gains traction

key_themes: Iron ore price weakness vs. Pilbara supply surge
Housing market deterioration and RBA rate-cut expectations
Sticky domestic inflation (grocery, housing) vs. global disinflation
Energy transition policy tensions (clean energy retreat vs. data-centre demand)
Labour market fragility (Qantas, fruit grower layoffs)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and bank exposure; monitor NPL trends and RBA policy response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price decline pressuring materials earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron-ore exposure; favour gold and diversified miners
Hedge energy exposure; favour hedged airlines (QAN.AX) and domestic gas (SGP.AX)
Maintain cash buffer; avoid event-driven political bets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sticky domestic inflation delaying RBA cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, growth) only on confirmed cut; hold quality dividend payers
Monitor consumer discretionary exposure; favour staples over cyclicals

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and diversified miners over pure iron-ore plays
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore under supply pressure; gold benefits from safe-haven flows and Gateway's WA discovery

opportunities.recommendation: Position for RBA rate cut via rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities
opportunities.rationale: Rate expectations rocketing; housing inflation may force earlier cut despite weak property data

opportunities.recommendation: Add domestic energy and gas exposure on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz risk premium; Virgin hedged; SGP benefits from gas demand and data-centre power

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight CSL on weight-loss drug demand surge
opportunities.rationale: August data shows strong appetite for GLP-1 drugs; CSL dominant in Australian pharma

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce pure iron-ore and housing-linked exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore supply glut and housing crash signals create downside risk for FMG, property REITs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge against political and policy uncertainty with quality dividend payers
defensive_moves.rationale: By-election losses and regulatory shifts create volatility; banks and staples offer income

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor insurance sector for ASIC regulatory action
defensive_moves.rationale: Cash-settlement shortchanging of policyholders may trigger enforcement, pressuring valuations

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile; oil-driven energy strength offsets iron-ore and housing weakness. RBA rate-cut expectations provide a floor but sticky inflation caps upside. Expect 2–3% range-bound trading in ^AXJO over next 4–6 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Housing correction and iron-ore supply overhang create structural headwinds for materials and property. Energy transition policy and data-centre demand offer medium-term growth pockets. RBA easing cycle, if confirmed, supports financials and REITs by Q1 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and housing inflation data
Iron ore contract price trajectory (Pilbara supply)
US Jackson Hole / Fed policy spillover
Australian CPI and retail sales print
watch_list: RBA cash rate and market-implied cut probability
Brent crude and Hormuz shipping status
ASIC enforcement actions on insurance sector
Q3 earnings season (banks, miners) starting late Sept
